Container.Name: Card-Hub
Container.Overview: Self-hosted trading card / sports card collection manager, modeled after Ludex. Collection tracking (sports and TCG), grading submission tracking with a profit- potential ROI calculator, consignment tracking, want lists with shareable public links, decks/binders, a trade ledger, and sales/profit reporting -- all backed by a local SQLite database, no cloud account required. Scan cards with a USB webcam or your phone's browser camera, with barcode/QR scanning for cert numbers and on-device OCR text extraction. Live card lookup and pricing for Pokemon (TCGdex), Yu-Gi-Oh (YGOPRODeck), and Magic: The Gathering (Scryfall) -- all free, keyless, and wired up out of the box. Export your collection to Excel, CSV, or PDF (including a photo catalog and printable QR label sheets) for use elsewhere, or import from another app's CSV/Excel export with your own column mapping.
